property_summary: Calling requestPrice through the test contract should not revert (i.e., onlyOptimisticAsserter allows the optimistic asserter address configured in C to call it, so a normal external caller can successfully invoke requestPrice).
change_summary: Tighten the access check to require sender be address(0), effectively making onlyOptimisticAsserter always revert for normal callers and preventing the event from being emitted; this changes observable behavior of requestPrice.
